protocol.scope: Source-reported commitments linked to existing quotations. No purchase, shipment execution, arbitrary domain or global cross-source commitment identity claim.
protocol.selection: No gold labels passed to discovery or validation. All failures retained; no retries or answer-based selection.
protocol.safety: Source-reported claims only. The policy is a structural/adoption boundary, not semantic accuracy certification.
protocol.shadowRegistry: Starts with frozen quotations only. Updated by neutral structural checks for allowed sources and existing parent references, never gold answers. All arms later replay the same plans.
protocol.bootstrap: Authored initial quotation fixture; no future concepts in the initial model or discovery prompt.
protocol.developmentRevision: v1 retained: six structural failures, uncertain treatment of explicit unfamiliar facts, and a scoped-identity guard bug found during replay. v2 supplies host limits and authorized reference context explicitly and clarifies discovery versus uncertainty. Cases and semantic aliases unchanged; this is development evidence on reused cases, not a new holdout.
